question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **Flying by the seat of our pants**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Acting without preparation**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Flying by the seat of our pants"** means doing something without any prior planning or preparation. It refers to making decisions or acting spontaneously in the moment without knowing the outcome. (बिना किसी तैयारी के काम करना) • **Example:** We had no map or navigation tools, so we just flew by the seat of our pants to find our way back home. • This idiom is often used when people are in situations where they have no prior experience or plan and rely on their instincts or intuition instead. (आकस्मिक परिस्थितियों में बिना योजना के काम करना) • **Example:** With no script in hand, the actor had to fly by the seat of his pants during the performance. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Acting without preparation**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Planning everything in advance** (सब कुछ पहले से योजना बनाना) • **Example:** She planned everything in advance for her wedding to ensure nothing went wrong. • **Option 3: Feeling nervous before doing something** (कुछ करने से पहले घबराहट महसूस करना) • **Example:** He always feels nervous before giving a speech, but he performs well eventually. • **Option 4: Taking everything slowly** (सब कुछ धीरे-धीरे करना) • **Example:** After the accident, she decided to take everything slowly and focus on her recovery. 35:T90e, The correct answer is **option 2.**
